 POST HEARING BRIEF OF INTERVENORS JEFF AND TOY JOYCE (PARTY 64)

       Intervenors, Jeff Joyce and Toy Joyce (Party 64), file their post hearing brief.

       1.      Intervenors Jeff and Toy Joyce have objected to any transmission line route

that includes segment link E11. The evidence presented demonstrates that no CNN should

be granted which includes Link E11 for at least these reasons.

            a. Of all the proposed routes, those which include E11 directly impact the most

               habitable structures – contrary to accepted standards and policies.

            b. The routes that would include link E11 would run parallel to and nearby Salado

               Creek – contrary to accepted standards and policies.

            c. The routes that would include link E11 would require clear cutting significant,

               hundred-year-old trees – contrary to accepted standards and policies.

       2.      The need for the proposed CNN is doubtful. If the ALJ’s and/or the PUC find

any such need – the route should never include Link E11.
